###############################################################################
# Power Without War: trade talks display mirror (GENERATED by
# tools/pww_diplo_gen_talks.py; edit the generator, not this file).
#
# pww_diplo_bundle_mirror (sender scope): copies the bundle arrays into plain
# per-slot variables the GUI and scripted loc read (pww_dbk_<n> kind,
# pww_dbx_<n>, pww_dba_<n> amount, pww_dbs_<n> lease state, pww_dbu_<n> lease
# output, pww_dbf_<n> the giver's figure: free factories, political power a
# day or stock; resource rows pww_dbss/sp (sender short/spare) and
# pww_dbts/tp (target); pww_dbp_<n> the target's appetite for a payment,
# 1 high, 2 low), the market values (pww_dbv_<n> per row,
# pww_dbm_t0 / t1 totals, each with a
# _f format flag; pww_dbm_bx the balance marker's x) and the add-menu figures
# (pww_dmg<side>_*: civ, pp, r<res>_sp/_sh, e<eq>, s<res>, top/topa) and
# enabled rows pww_dbm_en_<row>. Side 0 figures are the sender's, side 1 the
# target's.
# pww_diplo_bundle_snapshot_recv (sender scope, at delivery): copies everything
# the receive window reads to its own namespace on the sender (pww_drx_<name
# without pww_>). The receive window reads only those, the send window only
# the live mirror: an incoming proposal cannot repaint an open send window,
# and the sender's later drafting cannot repaint an open receive window.
###############################################################################

# in pww_dgm_n (net balance). out pww_dgm_sh (shortfall), pww_dgm_sp (spare),
# both rounded and never negative.
pww_diplo_mirror_net = {
	set_temp_variable = { pww_dgm_sp = pww_dgm_n }
	round_temp_variable = pww_dgm_sp
	set_temp_variable = { pww_dgm_sh = pww_dgm_sp }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_dgm_sh = -1 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_dgm_sp min = 0 max = 99999 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_dgm_sh min = 0 max = 99999 }
}

# Sender scope. pww_dbm_en_<row> for the open menu side and page.
pww_diplo_menu_enable = {
	set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_0 = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_4 = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_5 = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_6 = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_7 = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_8 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_dbm_side = 0 } check_variable = { pww_dbm_page = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_dgm_hc = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_dgm_hp = 0 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 4
			value = pww_dgm_i
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dob_k^pww_dgm_i = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_dgm_hc = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dob_k^pww_dgm_i = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_dgm_hp = 1 } }
		}
		set_variable = { pww_dmh_has1 = pww_dgm_hc }
		set_variable = { pww_dmh_has2 = pww_dgm_hp }
		if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_r0_pr > 0.999 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_r1_pr > 0.999 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_r2_pr > 0.999 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_r3_pr > 0.999 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_r4_pr > 0.999 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_r5_pr > 0.999 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_r6_pr > 0.999 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_0 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_civ > 0.999 } check_variable = { pww_dgm_hc = 0 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_1 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dgm_hp = 0 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_2 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_e0 > pww_dmg0_q0 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_e1 > pww_dmg0_q1 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_e2 > pww_dmg0_q2 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_e3 > pww_dmg0_q3 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_e4 > pww_dmg0_q4 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_e5 > pww_dmg0_q5 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_e6 > pww_dmg0_q6 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_e7 > pww_dmg0_q7 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_3 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_l0 = 1 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_l1 = 1 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_l2 = 1 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_l3 = 1 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_l4 = 1 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_l5 = 1 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_l6 = 1 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_l7 = 1 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_4 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_s0 > 0 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_s1 > 0 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_s2 > 0 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_s3 > 0 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_s4 > 0 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_s5 > 0 } check_variable = { pww_dmg0_s6 > 0 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_5 = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_dbm_side = 0 } check_variable = { pww_dbm_page = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_r0_pr > 0.999 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_0 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_r1_pr > 0.999 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_1 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_r2_pr > 0.999 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_2 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_r3_pr > 0.999 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_3 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_r4_pr > 0.999 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_4 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_r5_pr > 0.999 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_5 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_r6_pr > 0.999 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_6 = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_dbm_side = 0 } check_variable = { pww_dbm_page = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_e0 < pww_dmg0_q0 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_0 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_e1 < pww_dmg0_q1 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_1 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_e2 < pww_dmg0_q2 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_2 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_e3 < pww_dmg0_q3 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_3 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_e4 < pww_dmg0_q4 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_4 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_e5 < pww_dmg0_q5 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_5 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_e6 < pww_dmg0_q6 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_6 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_e7 < pww_dmg0_q7 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_7 = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_dbm_side = 0 } check_variable = { pww_dbm_page = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_l0 = 1 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_0 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_l1 = 1 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_1 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_l2 = 1 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_2 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_l3 = 1 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_3 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_l4 = 1 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_4 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_l5 = 1 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_5 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_l6 = 1 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_6 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_l7 = 1 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_7 = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_dbm_side = 0 } check_variable = { pww_dbm_page = 4 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_s0 > 0 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_0 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_s1 > 0 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_1 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_s2 > 0 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_2 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_s3 > 0 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_3 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_s4 > 0 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_4 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_s5 > 0 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_5 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg0_s6 > 0 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_6 = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_dbm_side = 1 } check_variable = { pww_dbm_page = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_dgm_hc = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_dgm_hp = 0 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 4
			end = 8
			value = pww_dgm_i
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dob_k^pww_dgm_i = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_dgm_hc = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dob_k^pww_dgm_i = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_dgm_hp = 1 } }
		}
		set_variable = { pww_dmh_has1 = pww_dgm_hc }
		set_variable = { pww_dmh_has2 = pww_dgm_hp }
		if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_r0_pr > 0.999 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_r1_pr > 0.999 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_r2_pr > 0.999 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_r3_pr > 0.999 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_r4_pr > 0.999 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_r5_pr > 0.999 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_r6_pr > 0.999 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_0 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_civ > 0.999 } check_variable = { pww_dgm_hc = 0 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_1 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dgm_hp = 0 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_2 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_e0 > pww_dmg1_q0 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_e1 > pww_dmg1_q1 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_e2 > pww_dmg1_q2 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_e3 > pww_dmg1_q3 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_e4 > pww_dmg1_q4 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_e5 > pww_dmg1_q5 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_e6 > pww_dmg1_q6 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_e7 > pww_dmg1_q7 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_3 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_l0 = 1 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_l1 = 1 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_l2 = 1 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_l3 = 1 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_l4 = 1 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_l5 = 1 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_l6 = 1 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_l7 = 1 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_4 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_s0 > 0 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_s1 > 0 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_s2 > 0 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_s3 > 0 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_s4 > 0 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_s5 > 0 } check_variable = { pww_dmg1_s6 > 0 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_5 = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_dbm_side = 1 } check_variable = { pww_dbm_page = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_r0_pr > 0.999 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_0 = 1 } }

		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_r6_pr > 0.999 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_6 = 1 } }

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_dbm_side = 1 } check_variable = { pww_dbm_page = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_e0 < pww_dmg1_q0 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_0 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_e1 < pww_dmg1_q1 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_1 = 1 } }

		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_e4 < pww_dmg1_q4 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_4 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_e5 < pww_dmg1_q5 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_5 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_e6 < pww_dmg1_q6 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_6 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_e7 < pww_dmg1_q7 } } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_7 = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_dbm_side = 1 } check_variable = { pww_dbm_page = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_l0 = 1 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_0 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_l1 = 1 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_1 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_l2 = 1 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_2 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_l3 = 1 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_3 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_l4 = 1 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_4 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_l5 = 1 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_5 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_l6 = 1 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_6 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_l7 = 1 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_7 = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_dbm_side = 1 } check_variable = { pww_dbm_page = 4 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_s0 > 0 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_0 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_s1 > 0 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_1 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_s2 > 0 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_2 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_s3 > 0 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_3 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_s4 > 0 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_4 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_s5 > 0 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_5 = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_dmg1_s6 > 0 } } set_variable = { pww_dbm_en_6 = 1 } }
	}
}
